home.hero_subtitle: A national student innovation reality competition organised by Radio Televisyen Malaysia (RTM).
home.about_body: Junior Innovathon 2026 discovers innovation talent among primary and secondary students across Malaysia through online registration, zone screening, and live studio judging.
home.episodes_subtitle: Live studio judging, broadcast on RTM.
home.sponsors_note: Jointly organised with government agencies and industry partners.
home.cta_banner_body: Register your school team and join Malaysia's biggest innovation competition for students.

rules.title: Competition Rules
rules.intro: Please read the entry rules carefully before registering.

eligibility.team: Each team consists of THREE students and ONE teacher as mentor.
eligibility.one_team: A participant may join ONLY ONE team.
eligibility.school: Participants must be students registered at a school in the KPM School Database.

submission.deadline: Submission is subject to the Event's registration closing date.

rules.note: All rules are subject to change without prior notice.

footer.about: The official portal of Junior Innovathon 2026, organised by Radio Televisyen Malaysia (RTM) / Department of Broadcasting Malaysia.
